channel.title: OpenShellOrg News
channel.description: Standards, tooling, and the evolution of OpenShellOrg.

item.title: Tool runs leave the scrollback
item.description: OpenShellOrg published architecture for compilers as structured Tool Runs — shared daemon, embeddable library, and per-command channels — instead of treating stderr as the product.

item.title: PlayTime as a shell-boundary cousin
item.description: A document runner that spawns argv without a shell rhymes with OpenShellOrg. It is being built in Dev-Centr scriptbook. We are not moving it.

item.title: We’re partnering with DevCentr (on purpose)
item.description: OpenShellOrg and DevCentr are aligning hard on shells, entrypoints, and toolchain honesty — without merging into one mega-org.

item.title: Docs that match how we work
item.description: Why we moved org docs to Antora with Valentus, and how every main repo became a docs component.

item.title: Hello, OpenShellOrg
item.description: Why this organization exists, and what we are building first.
